rules.unit: One upstream module and configuration pair. Every pinned configuration remains required until an explicit reviewed exclusion.
rules.missing: No audited implementation for this exact configuration. A partial or legacy port can still exist.
rules.implemented: A registered model-owned scenario and byte-identical upstream module/configuration reference exist. Semantic equivalence is not established.
rules.locallyChecked: Complete focused diagnostics have retained results for the recorded source SHA and matching hosted toolchain.
rules.hostedMatch: Retained hosted evidence for the recorded source SHA establishes complete initial states, states, labeled edges, and all selected property outcomes.
rules.familyCompletion: Every required configuration is a hosted match. All module dispositions and legacy cleanup are complete. Partial coverage never counts.
rules.evidence: A successful job, count, digest, timeout, or truncated graph alone cannot establish a match. Historical evidence needs explicit review before credit.
rules.dsl: Each criterion needs complete acceptance evidence. Each new capability must name an upstream configuration and acceptance criteria.
rules.unconfiguredModules: No published configuration is not an exclusion. Unclassified modules require review before family completion.

ci.lastKnownFailure: Hosted Swift compilation selected symbolic StateExpr equality in TypedFacadeContractTests. The explicit Bool fix awaits final hosted results.
ci.toolchainGap: Command Line Tools 16.4 supports focused SwiftPM diagnostics with the same SDK build shown in hosted Apple logs. Full Xcode 16.4 is absent locally. Earlier beta-toolchain passes remain uncredited.

localDiagnostics.result: The inventory and ledger contracts passed. Both Dining configurations produced one initial state, 67 states, and 335 edges. Native property checks and graph-edge dispatch replay passed.
